mapper.select: SELECT l.equipment_id AS "equipmentId", l.recorded_at AS "recordedAt", l.status AS "status", l.temperature AS "temperature", l.vibration AS "vibration" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT equipment_id FROM production_performance) e CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT s.equipment_id, s.recorded_at, s.status, s.temperature, s.vibration FROM equipment_sensor_log s WHERE s.equipment_id = e.equipment_id ORDER BY s.recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) l ORDER BY l.equipment_id

SELECT recorded_at AS "recordedAt", status AS "status", temperature AS "temperature", vibration AS "vibration" FROM equipment_sensor_log WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND recorded_at >= now() - #{minutes} * INTERVAL '1 minute' ORDER BY recorded_at

SELECT equipment_id AS "equipmentId", status AS "status", count(*) AS "seconds" FROM equipment_sensor_log WHERE recorded_at >= now() - #{minutes} * INTERVAL '1 minute' GROUP BY equipment_id, status ORDER BY equipment_id, status

WITH logs AS ( SELECT recorded_at, status, LAG(status) OVER (ORDER BY recorded_at) AS prev_status, LAG(recorded_at) OVER (ORDER BY recorded_at) AS prev_at FROM equipment_sensor_log WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND recorded_at >= now() - #{minutes} * INTERVAL '1 minute' ), marked AS ( SELECT recorded_at, status, CASE WHEN prev_status IS DISTINCT FROM status OR recorded_at - prev_at > INTERVAL '5 seconds' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_start FROM logs ), grouped AS ( SELECT recorded_at, status, SUM(is_start) OVER (ORDER BY recorded_at) AS segment FROM marked ) SELECT status AS "status", min(recorded_at) AS "startedAt", CASE WHEN segment = (SELECT max(segment) FROM grouped) AND max(recorded_at) >= now() - INTERVAL '5 seconds' THEN NULL ELSE max(recorded_at) + INTERVAL '1 second' END AS "endedAt", count(*)::int AS "seconds" FROM grouped GROUP BY segment, status ORDER BY min(recorded_at) DESC
